label: ask-rising/shares
sql:
SELECT coalesce(nullIf(p.TopicName, ''), nullIf(t.Attributes['metadata.topic'], '')) AS topic,
  countIf(t.OccurredAt >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}) AS in_period,
  countIf(t.OccurredAt < {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}) AS in_previous
FROM traces AS t
LEFT JOIN topics AS p ON p.TopicId = t.TopicId
WHERE (t.TenantId, t.TraceId) IN (SELECT TenantId, TraceId FROM trace_metrics WHERE Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND OccurredAt >= subtractDays(subtractSeconds({dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, dateDiff('second', {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})), 1)) AND ( t.OccurredAt >= subtractSeconds({dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, dateDiff('second', {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})) AND t.OccurredAt < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime}
  AND topic IS NOT NULL)
GROUP BY topic

label: ask-rising/daily
sql:
SELECT addSeconds(toStartOfInterval(subtractSeconds(t.OccurredAt, 345600), INTERVAL {dashboard_context_granularity_seconds:UInt32} SECOND), 345600) AS bucket,
  coalesce(nullIf(p.TopicName, ''), nullIf(t.Attributes['metadata.topic'], '')) AS topic,
  count() AS traces
FROM traces AS t
LEFT JOIN topics AS p ON p.TopicId = t.TopicId
WHERE (t.TenantId, t.TraceId) IN (SELECT TenantId, TraceId FROM trace_metrics WHERE Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND OccurredAt >= subtractDays(subtractSeconds({dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, dateDiff('second', {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})), 1)) AND ( t.OccurredAt >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime} AND t.OccurredAt < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime}
  AND topic IS NOT NULL)
GROUP BY bucket, topic
ORDER BY bucket

label: cost-by-segment/units
sql:
WITH (
  SELECT multiIf(
    countIf(Attributes['langwatch.customer_id'] != '') > 0, 'langwatch.customer_id',
    countIf(Attributes['metadata.document_type'] != '') > 0, 'metadata.document_type',
    countIf(Attributes['metadata.language'] != '') > 0, 'metadata.language',
    countIf(Attributes['metadata.team'] != '') > 0, 'metadata.team',
    countIf(Attributes['metadata.flow'] != '') > 0, 'metadata.flow',
    countIf(Attributes['metadata.segment'] != '') > 0, 'metadata.segment',
    countIf(Attributes['metadata.topic'] != '') > 0, 'metadata.topic',
    countIf(Attributes['langwatch.labels'] NOT IN ('', '[]')) > 0, 'langwatch.labels',
    '')
  FROM traces
  WHERE (traces.TenantId, traces.TraceId) IN (SELECT TenantId, TraceId FROM trace_metrics WHERE Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND OccurredAt >= subtractDays(subtractSeconds({dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, dateDiff('second', {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})), 1)) AND ( OccurredAt >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime} AND OccurredAt < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})
) AS unit_key
SELECT unit_key, if(unit_key = 'langwatch.labels', JSONExtractString(Attributes['langwatch.labels'], 1),
  Attributes[unit_key]) AS unit, sum(TotalCost) AS cost
FROM traces
WHERE (traces.TenantId, traces.TraceId) IN (SELECT TenantId, TraceId FROM trace_metrics WHERE Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND OccurredAt >= subtractDays(subtractSeconds({dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, dateDiff('second', {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})), 1)) AND ( OccurredAt >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime} AND OccurredAt < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})
GROUP BY unit
ORDER BY cost DESC
LIMIT 6

label: ext-human-review/trend
sql:
SELECT addSeconds(toStartOfInterval(subtractSeconds(OccurredAt, 345600), INTERVAL {dashboard_context_granularity_seconds:UInt32} SECOND), 345600) AS bucket,
  countIf((Attributes['metadata.sent_to_review'] != ''
    OR Attributes['metadata.outcome'] != '')) AS documents,
  countIf((Attributes['metadata.sent_to_review'] = 'true'
    OR Attributes['metadata.outcome'] = 'handover')) AS sent
FROM traces
WHERE (traces.TenantId, traces.TraceId) IN (SELECT TenantId, TraceId FROM trace_metrics WHERE Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND OccurredAt >= subtractDays(subtractSeconds({dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, dateDiff('second', {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})), 1)) AND ( OccurredAt >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime} AND OccurredAt < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})
GROUP BY bucket
ORDER BY bucket

label: ext-human-review/summary
sql:
SELECT count() AS traces,
  countIf((Attributes['metadata.sent_to_review'] != ''
    OR Attributes['metadata.outcome'] != '')) AS documents,
  countIf((Attributes['metadata.sent_to_review'] = 'true'
    OR Attributes['metadata.outcome'] = 'handover')) AS sent,
  countIf((Attributes['metadata.sent_to_review'] != ''
    OR Attributes['metadata.outcome'] != '') AND OccurredAt < subtractSeconds({dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime}, intDiv(dateDiff('second', {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime}), 2))) AS documents_first,
  countIf((Attributes['metadata.sent_to_review'] = 'true'
    OR Attributes['metadata.outcome'] = 'handover') AND OccurredAt < subtractSeconds({dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime}, intDiv(dateDiff('second', {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime}), 2))) AS sent_first
FROM traces
WHERE (traces.TenantId, traces.TraceId) IN (SELECT TenantId, TraceId FROM trace_metrics WHERE Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND OccurredAt >= subtractDays(subtractSeconds({dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, dateDiff('second', {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})), 1)) AND ( OccurredAt >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime} AND OccurredAt < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})

    '')
  FROM traces

) AS unit_key
SELECT unit_key, if(unit_key = 'langwatch.labels', JSONExtractString(Attributes['langwatch.labels'], 1),
  Attributes[unit_key]) AS unit,

    OR Attributes['metadata.outcome'] != '')) AS documents,

    OR Attributes['metadata.outcome'] = 'handover')) AS sent

label: gen-acceptance/actions
sql:
SELECT addSeconds(toStartOfInterval(subtractSeconds(OccurredAt, 345600), INTERVAL {dashboard_context_granularity_seconds:UInt32} SECOND), 345600) AS bucket,
  Attributes['metadata.output_action'] AS action,
  count() AS outputs
FROM traces
WHERE (traces.TenantId, traces.TraceId) IN (SELECT TenantId, TraceId FROM trace_metrics WHERE Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND OccurredAt >= subtractDays(subtractSeconds({dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, dateDiff('second', {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})), 1)) AND ( OccurredAt >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime} AND OccurredAt < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime}
  AND Attributes['metadata.output_action'] != '')
GROUP BY bucket, action
ORDER BY bucket

label: gen-acceptance/seen
sql:
SELECT 1 AS present
FROM traces
WHERE (traces.TenantId, traces.TraceId) IN (SELECT TenantId, TraceId FROM trace_metrics WHERE Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)}) AND ( OccurredAt >= subtractDays(now(), 90)
  AND Attributes['metadata.output_action'] != '')
LIMIT 1

label: gen-dropoff/main
sql:
SELECT count() AS traces,
  countIf(Attributes['metadata.output_action'] != '') AS generated,
  countIf(Attributes['metadata.output_action'] IN ('accepted', 'edited')) AS used,
  countIf(Attributes['metadata.output_action'] = 'accepted') AS accepted
FROM traces
WHERE (traces.TenantId, traces.TraceId) IN (SELECT TenantId, TraceId FROM trace_metrics WHERE Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND OccurredAt >= subtractDays(subtractSeconds({dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, dateDiff('second', {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})), 1)) AND ( OccurredAt >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime} AND OccurredAt < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})

label: data-health/fields
sql:
SELECT 'all' AS field, uniqExact(TraceId) AS traces
FROM trace_metrics
WHERE trace_metrics.Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND ( OccurredAt >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime} AND OccurredAt < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})
LIMIT 1
UNION ALL
SELECT 'model' AS field, uniqExact(TraceId) AS traces
FROM trace_metrics
WHERE trace_metrics.Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND ( OccurredAt >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime} AND OccurredAt < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime}
  AND notEmpty(Models))
LIMIT 1
UNION ALL
SELECT 'cost' AS field, uniqExact(TraceId) AS traces
FROM trace_metrics
WHERE trace_metrics.Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND ( OccurredAt >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime} AND OccurredAt < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime}
  AND (TotalCost IS NOT NULL OR empty(Models)))
LIMIT 1
UNION ALL
SELECT 'user' AS field, uniqExact(TraceId) AS traces
FROM trace_metrics
WHERE trace_metrics.Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND ( OccurredAt >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime} AND OccurredAt < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime}
  AND UserId IS NOT NULL)
LIMIT 1
UNION ALL
SELECT 'conversation' AS field, uniqExact(TraceId) AS traces
FROM trace_metrics
WHERE trace_metrics.Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND ( OccurredAt >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime} AND OccurredAt < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime}
  AND ConversationId IS NOT NULL)
LIMIT 1
UNION ALL
SELECT 'labels' AS field, uniqExact(TraceId) AS traces
FROM trace_metrics
WHERE trace_metrics.Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND ( OccurredAt >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime} AND OccurredAt < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime}
  AND notEmpty(Labels))
LIMIT 1
UNION ALL
SELECT 'outcome' AS field, uniqExact(TraceId) AS traces
FROM traces
WHERE (traces.TenantId, traces.TraceId) IN (SELECT TenantId, TraceId FROM trace_metrics WHERE Source IN {dashboard_context_sources:Array(String)} AND OccurredAt >= subtractDays(subtractSeconds({dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, dateDiff('second', {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime}, {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})), 1)) AND ( OccurredAt >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime} AND OccurredAt < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime}
  AND Attributes['metadata.outcome'] != '')
LIMIT 1
